newsitem.title: INDIA: India seeks 750 megawatts from power plant upgrade.
newsitem.headline: India seeks 750 megawatts from power plant upgrade.

text.p: India plans to add 750 megawatts of generation capacity during 1997-98 (April-March) through renovation and modernisation of existing plants, Power Minister Y.K. Alagh said on Tuesday.

"The modernisation and rehabilitation of existing power plants should add 750 megawatts of capacity this year and 1,000 megawatt next year," Alagh said at a seminar organised by the Indo-American Chamber of Commerce.
Alagh said 56 thermal projects and 29 hydropower projects had been identified for renovation and modernisation.
He said a legislation for encouraging private sector investment in transmission facilities would be introduced in the next session of Parliament.
On the need for reforms in power distribution, Alagh said his ministry was considering pilot cooperative projects in selected regions. -- New Delhi Newsroom (91) 11-301-2024; Fax (91) 11-301-4043
